Trip Distribution & HBW Destination Choice

viewof globalCalibRun = {
  const options = calib_runs_ojs;
  if (options.length === 0) {
    return Inputs.select([], {label: "Calibration Run:", disabled: true});
  }
  // Default to the run with the highest numeric ID (e.g. "C51" over "C50"),
  // not just the last entry in `options` -- that list comes from a plain
  // alphabetical sort (see list_available_runs in _validation_scripts.py),
  // which only happens to match numeric order today because both IDs have
  // the same digit count ("C9" would sort after "C50" alphabetically despite
  // being numerically earlier).
  const runNumber = id => {
    const m = /(\d+)/.exec(id);
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : -Infinity;
  };
  const latestRun = options.reduce((best, id) => runNumber(id) > runNumber(best) ? id : best, options[0]);
  const stored = window.localStorage.getItem("tdmcalib:selectedRun");
  const initial = options.includes(stored) ? stored : latestRun;
  const input = Inputs.select(options, {label: "Calibration Run:", value: initial});
  // Inputs.select renders the label text and <select> on the same line by
  // default -- force them onto separate lines. Insert relative to the
  // select's actual parent (not assumed to be the <label>, which varies by
  // Inputs version) so this doesn't throw if they aren't nested.
  const selectEl = input.querySelector("select");
  selectEl?.parentNode.insertBefore(document.createElement("br"), selectEl);
  input.classList.add("calib-run-bar");
  input.addEventListener("input", () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem("tdmcalib:selectedRun", input.value);
  });

  // Quarto's own OJS runtime places this cell's returned node into its
  // normal in-page output slot right after this function returns -- moving
  // it into the sidebar synchronously, before that happens, would just get
  // undone a moment later. Deferring to the next tick runs this after that
  // placement, so the move actually sticks.
  setTimeout(() => {
    const sidebar = document.querySelector("#quarto-sidebar");
    const menu = sidebar?.querySelector(".sidebar-menu-container");
    if (!sidebar || !menu) return; // no docked sidebar -- stays inline as a .calib-run-bar
    input.classList.remove("calib-run-bar");
    input.classList.add("calib-run-sidebar");
    sidebar.insertBefore(input, menu);
  }, 0);

  return input;
}

Trip Distribution

The model used the 2012 Household Travel Survey to calibrate trip lengths for internal and external person trips. Trips were calibrated based on generalized cost trip length frequencies and validated to time and distance trip length frequencies and average trip lengths. The validation results are shown in Figure 1 and Figure 2. Trip lengths by time and distance met the validation targets and aligned closely with target data.

No target data was available for internal and external commercial vehicle calibration. CV trips were calibrated based on previous model estimation and validated relative to person work and other trip lengths.

Trip Length Frequency Validation

The following trip length frequency charts have been updated to exclude intrazonal trips. The distance charts only include data beyond 0, the time charts only include data beyond 4, and the general cost charts only include data beyond 4. Please note that these values were calculated at a mark where the majority of the trip would not be intrazonal trips. Intrazonal trips were analyzed separately.

dc_final = {

  return data.map(d => ({
    ...d,
    tmeMod: d.mod,
    tmeObs: d.obs,
    tmeErrorPct: d.obs > 0 ? (d.mod - d.obs) / d.obs : 0
  })).filter(d => d.tmeObs > 0 || d.tmeMod > 0);
}

Production & Attractions by Model

dc = {
  const modT = transpose(dist_sum_mod).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun);
  const obsT = transpose(dist_sum_obs);

  return modT.map(m => {
    const o = obsT.find(d =>
      d.p_DistLrg === m.p_DistLrg &&
      d.a_DistLrg === m.a_DistLrg &&
      d.Source === m.Source
    );

    if (!o || o.total_trips === 0) return null;

    return {
      p_DistLrg: m.p_DistLrg,
      a_DistLrg: m.a_DistLrg,
      Source: m.Source,
      tmeMod: m.total_trips,
      tmeObs: o.total_trips,
      // Added Percent Error calculation for the second chart
      tmeErrorPct: (m.total_trips - o.total_trips) / o.total_trips
    };
  }).filter(d => d !== null);
}

Production & Attractions by Vehicle Ownership & Income Category

vincs_list = Array.from(
  new Set(transpose(dist_sum_obs2).map(d => String(d.veh_inc).replace(/^HBW_/, "")))
).sort()

// Model Type Selection
viewof vSource_2 = Inputs.select(
  ["Destination Choice", "Gravity"],
  { label: "Model Type:", value: "Destination Choice" }
)

// Observed Data Selection
viewof vRemoveOutliers_2 = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "Remove outliers",
  value: true
})

// 2. DATA PROCESSING (Matches selected model source to selected observed data)
dc_2 = {
  const modT2 = transpose(dist_sum_mod2).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun);
  const obsT2 = vRemoveOutliers_2
    ? transpose(dist_sum_obs2_no_outliers)
    : transpose(dist_sum_obs2);

  return modT2.map(m => {
    const o = obsT2.find(d =>
      d.p_DistLrg === m.p_DistLrg &&
      d.a_DistLrg === m.a_DistLrg &&
      d.veh_inc === m.veh_inc
    );

    if (!o || o.total_trips === 0) return null;

    return {
      p_DistLrg: m.p_DistLrg,
      a_DistLrg: m.a_DistLrg,
      veh_inc: m.veh_inc,
      veh_inc_clean: String(m.veh_inc).replace(/^HBW_/, ""),
      Source: m.Source,
      tmeMod: m.total_trips,
      tmeObs: o.total_trips,
      tmeErrorPct: (m.total_trips - o.total_trips) / o.total_trips
    };
  }).filter(d => d !== null);
}

// 3. FINAL FILTERING
dc_filtered_2 = dc_2.filter(d => d.Source === vSource_2)

// 4. NOTEBOOK-MATCHED METRICS
slope_through_origin = (rows) => {
  const denominator = d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs * d.tmeObs);
  return denominator > 0
    ? d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs * d.tmeMod) / denominator
    : 0;
}

wmape = (rows) => {
  const totalObs = d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs);
  return totalObs > 0
    ? d3.sum(rows, d => Math.abs(d.tmeMod - d.tmeObs)) / totalObs
    : 0;
}

segment_summaries = vincs_list.map(seg => {
  const rows = dc_filtered_2.filter(d => d.veh_inc_clean === seg);
  return {
    seg,
    rows,
    slope: slope_through_origin(rows),
    wmape: wmape(rows),
    maxVal: d3.max(rows, d => Math.max(d.tmeObs, d.tmeMod)) || 1
  };
})

global_wmape_2 = wmape(dc_filtered_2)
avg_slope_2 = d3.mean(segment_summaries.filter(d => d.rows.length > 1), d => d.slope) || 0
obs_label_2 = vRemoveOutliers_2 ? "No Outliers" : "Standard"
segment_chart = (summary) => {
  const rows = summary.rows;
  const maxVal = summary.maxVal;
  const axisMax = maxVal * 1.1;
  const fanRatios = [0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3];
  const titleText = rows.length
    ? `${summary.seg} | Slope: ${d3.format(".2f")(summary.slope)} | Error: ${d3.format(".1%")(summary.wmape)}`
    : `${summary.seg} (No Data)`;

  return html`<div class="hbw-segment-chart">
    <h4>${titleText}</h4>
    ${Plot.plot({
      grid: true,
      width: 400,
      height: 315,
      marginLeft: 50,
      marginBottom: 42,
      x: { label: "Target Trips", domain: [0, axisMax] },
      y: { label: "Mod Trips", domain: [0, axisMax] },
      marks: [
        Plot.link(fanRatios, {
          x1: 0,
          y1: 0,
          x2: maxVal,
          y2: (r) => maxVal * r,
          stroke: "gray",
          strokeOpacity: (r) => r === 1 ? 1 : 0.25,
          strokeWidth: (r) => r === 1 ? 2 : 1,
          strokeDasharray: (r) => r === 1 ? null : "2 2"
        }),
        Plot.dot(rows, {
          x: "tmeObs",
          y: "tmeMod",
          r: 3,
          fill: themeModel,
          fillOpacity: 0.6,
          tip: true,
          title: (d) =>
            `District: ${d.p_DistLrg} to ${d.a_DistLrg}\n` +
            `Target: ${d3.format(",.0f")(d.tmeObs)}\n` +
            `Modeled: ${d3.format(",.0f")(d.tmeMod)}`
        }),
        Plot.line(
          [
            { x: 0, y: 0 },
            { x: maxVal, y: summary.slope * maxVal }
          ],
          {
            x: "x",
            y: "y",
            stroke: themeModel,
            strokeWidth: 2,
            strokeDasharray: "4 4"
          }
        )
      ]
    })}
  </div>`;
}

html`<div>
  <style>
    .hbw-segment-summary {
      font-weight: 600;
      margin: 0.75rem 0 1rem 0;
    }
    .hbw-segment-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(360px, 1fr));
      gap: 0.75rem;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .hbw-segment-chart h4 {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .hbw-segment-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <div class="hbw-segment-summary">
    Run: ${vSource_2} | Target: ${obs_label_2} | Global WMAPE: ${d3.format(".1%")(global_wmape_2)} | Avg Slope: ${d3.format(".2f")(avg_slope_2)}
  </div>
  <div class="hbw-segment-grid">
    ${segment_summaries.map(segment_chart)}
  </div>
</div>`
